phrase_pass_moved.cause: CBeatAnalyzeThread::analyze moves the grid to SongStructureAnalyze's first downbeat (analysis-beats.md § 8, analysis-phrase.md); ported (stages A/B)
phrase_pass_moved.result: all 21 moved grids now match rekordbox exactly
phrase_pass_moved.invariant: BPM, beat count, spacing, per-beat tempo and PQT2 µs remainders still match on all 21

unmoved_copies_identical: of the 5 click_128_offset1234 copies rekordbox did not move (mp3 x3, m4a aac, wav 96k), we leave all 5 alone and match exactly

phrase_pass_96k.result: not moved (first beat 296 ms), as rekordbox
phrase_pass_96k.cause: the phrase pass reads the rewound stream; the re-primed 96->48 kHz SRC is one input sample earlier, so its pre-ringing fails the silence test before the click (analysis-phrase.md § 1.4, § 6; decode.md § 8)

oracle_b: not applicable: high precision on (BALib v2 + madmom), see spec § 9
